contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #050: A counterexample to Griffiths’ positivity conjecture.
Audit the September 24, 2026 manuscript, resolving prop:limit for arbitrary positive rank on S=P^1 x P^1 and every fiber; extensions must distinguish analytic proof from exact algebraic replay.

definitions.f_m: coordinatewise m-th power map, degree m^2, f_m^*P=P^m
definitions.F: G dual for an arbitrary holomorphic vector bundle G of finite rank r>=1
definitions.psh: upper semicontinuous and subharmonic on every holomorphic disk
definitions.G_graph: the rank-two equalizer bundle defined by A,B,b=24 and D in staged Section 2; not the arbitrary G in prop:limit

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 050 (A counterexample to Griffiths’ positivity conjecture.; papers: Ample rank-two bundles on the quadric surface without Griffiths-positive metrics; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/050.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.

For every holomorphic G of positive rank on S, if f_m^*G tensor P has a smooth strictly Griffiths-positive Hermitian metric for infinitely many distinct positive integers m, there exists a finite nonnegative nonzero psh q on F=G dual such that for every x in S, q restricted to F_x is a positive semidefinite Hermitian quadratic.

The degree-normalized ramified trace of the dual squared norm using local m-th roots of a pulled-back P^{-1} frame is continuous and jointly psh, positive Hermitian quadratic on every fiber, and transforms by q_{m,gt}=|g|^{2/m}q_{m,t}.

After the manuscript global maximum normalization, a subsequence of local trace coefficient matrices converges strongly in L^p_loc for every finite p>=1 to locally bounded a.e. positive semidefinite Hermitian matrices with the untwisted transition law.

A locally essentially bounded a.e. positive semidefinite Hermitian matrix field whose base convolutions give jointly psh quadratics with nondecreasing radial scale has a unique finite psh representative quadratic on every fiber; representatives agree under holomorphic frame changes and base-coordinate changes.

For the strongly convergent normalized trace subsequence and its canonical everywhere-quadratic psh representative q, 0<=q(x,v)<=|v|_0^2 everywhere and max_{|v|_0=1}q=1. In particular the limit cannot collapse to zero.

For every d>=1, r>=1, G holomorphic of rank r on X=(P^1)^d, L=O(1,...,1), and distinct m_j tending to infinity with integers a_j such that a_j/m_j tends to zero, smooth Griffiths-semipositive metrics on f_{m_j}^*G tensor L^{a_j} imply an everywhere finite nonnegative psh Hermitian-quadratic q on G dual. Traces can be normalized and subsequenced so coefficients converge strongly in every finite L^p_loc and max_{|v|_0=1}q=1.

Staged prop:construction: the three b=24 graph identifications descend at all six nodes; the equalizer G_graph is locally free of rank two with both stated line quotients and dual gluing identities on D.
Staged prop:ampleness: for every m>=1, E_m=f_m^*G_graph tensor P is ample, with O_{P(E_m)}(n) very ample for every even n with n-1>=3m.

Staged prop:obstruction: every finite nonnegative psh function on G_graph dual that is a Hermitian quadratic on every fiber is zero, via ruling reduction, logarithmic curvature mass, and incompatible A,B invariant measures.
Staged thm:main: the graph equalizer bundle G_graph has every E_m ample but no smooth strictly Griffiths-positive metric on E_m for all sufficiently large m.

After the manuscript global maximum normalization, a subsequence of local trace coefficient matrices converges strongly in L^p_loc for every finite p>=1 to locally bounded a.e. positive semidefinite Hermitian matrices with the untwisted transition law.

claims.natural_statement: Staged lem:matrix-data: A,B are in SL_2(C), have trace 1, tr(A^{-1}B)=-sqrt(2), tr(AB)=1+sqrt(2), lift orders 6,6,8, projective A,B orders 3, no common eigenline, and AB has two positive reciprocal real eigenvalues of distinct moduli.
Staged lem:graph-divisor: D=Gamma_I union Gamma_A union Gamma_B is a reduced (3,3) divisor with six ordinary transverse double points and no triple point.

Staged proof of prop:construction: b=24 makes the tensor-power line maps agree at graph intersections, and the nodal exact sequence descends them to an isomorphism alpha; the local equalizer basis (1,h),(0,d) gives both surjective line quotients.

Staged equations symmetric-first through graded-lines: alternating the two quotient sequences produces the stated locally free line-factor filtration of Sym^n(f_m^*G_graph) for every even n, including coincident kernel fibers and nonreduced pulled-back divisors.

Staged global-generation step: for even n with n-1>=3m all listed factors of Sym^n(f_m^*G_graph) tensor P^{n-1} have nonnegative bidegrees, are globally generated with H^1=0, and extension lifting makes the full bundle globally generated.

Staged projective-embedding step: evaluation, relative Veronese, the base P embedding, and Segre give a closed immersion whose pulled-back hyperplane is O_{P(E_m)}(n), with the quotient-projectivization twists as stated.

Staged lem:ruling-reduction: a nonzero finite nonnegative fiberwise Hermitian-quadratic psh function on G_graph dual induces one nonzero psh squared seminorm on O_{P^1}(-24) invariant under the lifts of A and B.

Staged lem:seminorm-curvature: the logarithmic weights of a nonzero finite psh squared seminorm on a line bundle over a connected Riemann surface are subharmonic and locally integrable, glue to positive curvature measure, preserve lifted isometries, and have total mass 2*pi*b on O_{P^1}(-b).

Staged lem:no-invariant-measure: the stated projective A and B preserve no nonzero finite positive Borel measure on P^1, because AB concentrates its invariant measures on at most two fixed points while order-three A,B with no common eigenline cannot preserve such a support.

The symbolic two-index Hermitian polarization formulas for v^*Hv, generic complex 2 by 2 congruence, normal-frame inverse and norm mixed jets, and positive-modulus vanishing-twist normalization cancellation in verify.py are exact polynomial or positive-real power identities. The finite ramification and Jacobian fixtures are diagnostics only.

routes.retired_because: Superseded before evidence filing by R_LIMIT_VANISHING: the proof now states dimension-uniform trace and abstract compactness lemmas and preserves the exact maximum. This is a refinement of the plan, not a refutation of its original dimension-two obligations.

The initial route named fixed-twist dimension-two helper statements. R_GENERAL_VANISHING replaces it with explicitly dimension-uniform, sublinear-twist and compact-complex-base lemmas, so no specialized statement is silently used as a universal theorem.

Staged Section 4 explicitly gives the trace (1+|x|^{2/m})|v|^2: its raw limit has coefficient 1 at x=0 and 2 elsewhere and fails upper semicontinuity. An intrinsic representative, not a raw pointwise limit, is necessary.

Distributional or L^p convergence on the base says nothing about restrictions to a base-null divisor. Staged Remark rmk:canonical-limit explicitly excludes this route; graph relations must be evaluated on the recovered everywhere-defined function.
The constant locally psh matrices diag(1,1/j) converge to diag(1,0). Compactness permits loss of rank, so a proof needing a positive determinant of the limit would not establish the target.
